listings.byline: Comfortable & Private Unfurnished Apartments  Convenient Living in Bracken Ridge
listings.description:
Welcome to your own private micro apartment, offering comfortable, low-maintenance living in a convenient Bracken Ridge location.

These well-designed apartments provide an excellent housing option for single professionals looking for an affordable, private place to call home. With your own kitchenette and bathroom, each apartment offers the comfort and independence of your own self-contained residence, while also providing access to shared communal facilities.

PLEASE NOTE: Due to Brisbane City Council regulations and fire safety requirements, only ONE occupant is permitted per unit. These properties are not suitable for couples, families, or pets, and overnight guests are not permitted.

** Apartments are unfurnished, photos are virtually staged. **

With only five apartments available, this is a fantastic opportunity to secure comfortable accommodation in a quiet location with excellent access to public transport, shops and major road networks.

Available Apartments

Ground Floor

Unit 1  $470 per week  Includes both secure garage parking spaces, Internal Garage Access to Unit
Unit 2  $380 per week  Includes Internal Storage Space- Street parking only

First Floor

Unit 3  $410 per week  Street parking only
Unit 4  LEASED
Unit 5  $445 per week  Street parking only


Features You'll Enjoy

 Comfortable, Functional Layouts  Thoughtfully designed to provide a practical living space with separate areas for relaxing, sleeping and preparing meals.

 Private Kitchenette  Each apartment includes its own kitchenette with quality appliances, making everyday cooking simple and convenient.

 Unfurnished  Bring your own furniture and personalise the space to suit your lifestyle.

 Private Bathroom  Enjoy the convenience of your own bathroom with a generous shower.

 Secure Access  Keyless digital entry offers added security and ease of access.

 Year-Round Comfort  Reverse-cycle air conditioning and ceiling fans help keep the apartment comfortable throughout every season.

 Shared Amenities  Residents have access to a communal downstairs kitchen and shared laundry facilities, including two washing machines, providing additional convenience.

Location Highlights

 Less than 100 metres to the nearest bus stop
 Approximately 3 km to Bald Hills Train Station
 Approximately 1.5 km to Bracken Ridge TAFE Campus
 Approximately 1.5 km to Woolworths & Bracken Ridge Tavern
 Approximately 1 km to Bracken Ridge Library
 Approximately 2 km to Bracken Ridge Plaza
 Approximately 8.5 km to the Brisbane Entertainment Centre
 Approximately 20 km (around 18 minutes) to Brisbane International Airport
 Approximately 28 km (around 30 minutes) to Brisbane CBD

With excellent access to the Gateway Motorway and M1, travelling north or south is quick and convenient, making this an ideal location for working professionals seeking affordable, private accommodation close to everyday amenities.

Inspections & Applications

After viewing the 3D Virtual Tour, you're invited to submit your application online. While the virtual tour provides a comprehensive overview of the property, a physical inspection is required before we can process your application or offer formal approval.

To book an inspection, simply click the "Book an Inspection" button and register your details. By registering, you'll receive instant notifications of any changes, updates or cancellations to your inspection. Please note that inspections without registered attendees may be cancelled without notice.

If you're looking for comfortable, self-contained accommodation that offers privacy, convenience and excellent value in a well-connected location, these apartments are well worth inspecting.
